'''Vel slugs''' were slimy, [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Slug (creature)/Legends|slugs]] served as a delicacy at the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] event on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. They could be eaten fresh or braised.<ref name="Cooking">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=daily|Challenge Dish: Ultimate Galactic Sampler|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>
